items.title: Electrolyte Interphase Engineering for Stable Zinc Anodes in Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries
items.summary: This paper studies aqueous zinc-ion battery anodes and reports an electrolyte additive that suppresses zinc dendrite growth, improves Coulombic efficiency, and stabilizes the zinc metal interface during long cycling.
items.abstract: Aqueous zinc-ion batteries are promising for safe and low-cost energy storage, but zinc dendrite formation and interfacial side reactions limit cycle life. We propose an electrolyte interphase engineering strategy that regulates zinc deposition and improves anode reversibility.
